prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the provided empty webcam background image to create version 3. Preserve the exact room, camera angle, framing, gray walls, wooden floor, plant, cabinet, ceramics, artwork, exposure and soft neutral daylight. Change ONLY the addition of one tasteful real wall-mounted LED neon sign, with a subtle localized glow.
Place the sign on the BACK WALL in its UPPER LEFT area, approximately x=14%-40%, y=10%-28% of the image. It must stay to the left of the central live person's head, which will occupy x=43%-65%, y=8%-48%. Do not center the sign behind the person. Do not cover the plant. The sign should be readable and realistic, with elegant neon tubing, discreet transparent acrylic mounting and a restrained YouTube creator studio aesthetic.
Exact text, with spelling and capitalization preserved:
First line, larger: "Carlos Gracia"
Second line, smaller: "Ia y Automatizaciones"
Spell Gracia exactly G-r-a-c-i-a, NOT Garcia. The second line begins capital I then lowercase a.
Use an attractive legible flowing neon script for Carlos Gracia in cool cyan-white and a clean highly legible compact neon sans-serif for the tagline in warm white. Readable at webcam size. The sign is switched on, with realistic tube highlights and a soft modest cyan halo immediately on the wall, no strong color spill into the room. No dramatic dimming of daylight, no dark gamer room, no excessive bloom obscuring letters.
Output only the photorealistic EMPTY ROOM background in the same landscape 16:9 composition. No person, chair, desk, extra words, logos or watermark. Preserve every other object and room geometry.

Edit ONLY the size and placement of the existing neon sign in this image. The neon wording, letter shapes, colors and two-line layout are correct: preserve EXACTLY 'Carlos Gracia' and 'Ia y Automatizaciones'. Make the WHOLE sign about 20% narrower and move it slightly LEFT so that every illuminated letter and its glow fit within x=13% to x=39% of the full image. Keep its top at approximately y=9%, and bottom above y=27%. The current sign's right edge is too close to where the person's head will appear; its new rightmost edge must stay left of x=39%. Keep it above the plant with no leaf overlap. Preserve absolutely everything else: same empty room pixels/layout, camera viewpoint, wall geometry, floor, plants, cabinet, art, soft daylight, no people. Photorealistic physical neon, no added elements, same16:9 output.
